Review follow-up: Reef's historical `openclaw.install.minHostVersion` still advertises `>=2026.7.2`. Align that metadata with the current-host-only policy for first-party packages in the release/package metadata work. The supported contract for this cutover is the current matching host; separately installing the new bundled plugin on an older host is unsupported, so the legacy implementation should not be restored. This finding does not change current-host behavior.

The earlier Reef sync-hook test finding is fixed: the assertions now exercise and await the async hooks.
